decisions: ObservationSeries stores TopicObservation values immutably and exposes deterministic topic/period ordering for later signal dynamics.
IntelligenceStore appends observations to the isolated intel_topic_observations table and lists them by topic, period and insertion id.
Observation metadata is serialized as JSON on disk and decoded on read; topic and period remain explicit fields for filtering and future dynamics.
No legacy database, external service or paid provider is involved.
risks: Period ordering is lexical and therefore expects canonical comparable period values such as YYYY-MM.
The persistence method is append-only and does not deduplicate repeated topic/period observations; aggregation belongs to later signal tasks.
The contract currently permits empty topic, period and negative counters; validation policy remains for the signal semantics audit.
